description: A tenant with one spare bedroom must decide whether to arrange a summer room-share with a prospective tenant and finalize the household terms after consulting the current housemate.

shared_context.S1: Imani's spare bedroom is available for a summer room-share from June 1 through August 31.
shared_context.S2: Imani decides whether to arrange the room-share and sets the final informal terms.
shared_context.S3: The room includes a bed, desk, and access to the shared kitchen and bathroom.
shared_context.S4: Imani's usual house-meeting practice is to call on Noah and Celeste one at a time for their practical terms, then read back the exact terms everyone has agreed to before making the final decision.

PF1.text: Noah can pay exactly $480 per month, plans to sleep at the house only on Monday through Friday nights, and will clean the shared bathroom once each week as part of the arrangement.

PF2.text: Celeste works overnight shifts and needs the house kept quiet from exactly 10:00 p.m. to 7:00 a.m.; she will agree to the room-share only if the incoming tenant has no overnight guests.

commitments.type: string; use 'weekly_bathroom_cleaning' for Noah's cleaning promise

acceptance_conditions: The room-share must be accepted with Noah as the selected tenant.
The monthly rent must be exactly $480.
Noah's occupancy must be limited to Monday through Friday nights.
The household must record a weekly shared-bathroom-cleaning commitment by Noah.
Quiet hours must be exactly 10:00 p.m. to 7:00 a.m.
Noah must have no overnight guests.

content_checks.C4: any(c['type'] == 'weekly_bathroom_cleaning' and c['target'] == 'Noah' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: Noah's stated terms change the settlement to Noah, exactly $480 per month, Monday-Friday-night occupancy, and a weekly bathroom-cleaning commitment.
Celeste's overnight-shift requirement changes the household rules to exactly 22:00-07:00 quiet hours and no overnight guests, and requires her condition to be cited.
